
```{r}
.plot_lines_multi_impl <- function(
  df,
  filters,
  ycol,  # NOW: can be length 1 or >1 (tick mode supports multi)
  labels = list(title = NULL, x = "Tick", y = ycol),
  show_rep = TRUE,
  cols = NULL,          # colors per filter (unchanged meaning)
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  tick_col = "tick",
  lwd_mean = 3,
  lwd_rep  = 1,
  rep_alpha = 0.35,
  xcol = tick_col,
  ltys = NULL,           # NEW: line types per ycol (tick mode only)
  style = "dot",
  cex_point = 1,
  show_ci = FALSE,       # draw a confidence band across replicates
  ci_level = 0.95,
  ci_alpha = 0.20
) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df), length(filters) >= 1, is.character(ycol))
  if (!is.numeric(ci_level) || length(ci_level) != 1 ||
      !is.finite(ci_level) || ci_level <= 0 || ci_level >= 1) {
    stop("ci_level must be a single number strictly between 0 and 1.")
  }
  if (!is.numeric(ci_alpha) || length(ci_alpha) != 1 ||
      !is.finite(ci_alpha) || ci_alpha < 0 || ci_alpha > 1) {
    stop("ci_alpha must be a single number between 0 and 1.")
  }

  # xcol default
  if (is.null(xcol)) xcol <- tick_col

  # Only require tick_col if used as x
  if (identical(xcol, tick_col) && !tick_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop("tick column '", tick_col, "' not found.")
  }

  # Validate ycol(s)
  if (!all(ycol %in% names(df))) {
    bad <- ycol[!(ycol %in% names(df))]
    stop("y column(s) not found in df: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Helper: apply one filter list to df (AND across fields; OR within vectors)
  apply_filter <- function(d, f) {
    keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(d))
    for (nm in names(f)) {
      if (!nm %in% names(d)) next
      v <- f[[nm]]
      keep <- keep & (d[[nm]] %in% v)
    }
    d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # Fix labels
  if (is.null(labels$y)) {
    labels$y <- if (length(ycol) == 1) ycol else paste(ycol, collapse = ", ")
  }
  if (is.null(labels$x) ||
      (identical(labels$x, "Tick") && !identical(xcol, tick_col))) {
    labels$x <- xcol
  }

  make_step_line <- function(dat) {
    dat <- dat[order(dat$tick), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(dat) <= 1) return(dat)

    out <- dat[1, , drop = FALSE]

    for (k in 2:nrow(dat)) {
      old_y <- dat$y[k - 1]
      new_y <- dat$y[k]
      new_t <- dat$tick[k]

      if (is.finite(old_y) && is.finite(new_y) && old_y != new_y) {
        # add point at the new generation but with old optimum
        out <- rbind(
          out,
          data.frame(tick = new_t, y = old_y)
        )
      }

      out <- rbind(out, dat[k, , drop = FALSE])
    }

    rownames(out) <- NULL
    out
  }

  # Compute a t confidence interval from one value per replicate at each x.
  # Averaging first avoids giving extra weight to replicates with duplicate rows.
  replicate_ci <- function(d, x_name, y_name) {
    if (!"rep" %in% names(d)) {
      stop("show_ci = TRUE requires a 'rep' column in df.")
    }

    rep_means <- aggregate(
      d[[y_name]],
      by = list(x = d[[x_name]], rep = d$rep),
      FUN = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    names(rep_means)[3] <- "y"

    out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(rep_means, rep_means$x), function(z) {
      n <- sum(is.finite(z$y))
      mu <- mean(z$y, na.rm = TRUE)
      se <- if (n > 1) stats::sd(z$y, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n) else 0
      margin <- if (n > 1) stats::qt((1 + ci_level) / 2, df = n - 1) * se else 0
      data.frame(x = z$x[1], mean = mu, lower = mu - margin, upper = mu + margin)
    }))
    out[order(out$x), , drop = FALSE]
  }

  plot_tick_mode <- function(df, filters, ycols, labels, show_rep, cols, xlim, ylim,
                             tick_col, lwd_mean, lwd_rep, rep_alpha, ltys,
                             show_ci, ci_alpha) {

    # colors per filter (original meaning)
    if (is.null(cols)) cols <- rep("black", length(filters))
    if (length(cols) < length(filters)) cols <- rep(cols, length.out = length(filters))

    # line types per y column
    if (is.null(ltys)) ltys <- rep(1, length(ycols))
    if (length(ltys) < length(ycols)) ltys <- rep(ltys, length.out = length(ycols))

    all_ticks <- numeric(0)
    all_vals  <- numeric(0)

    summaries <- lapply(seq_along(filters), function(i) {
      f <- filters[[i]]
      d <- apply_filter(df, f)

      d[[tick_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d[[tick_col]]))
      d$rep         <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d$rep))
      for (yc in ycols) d[[yc]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[yc]]))

      keep <- is.finite(d[[tick_col]]) & is.finite(d$rep)
      for (yc in ycols) keep <- keep & is.finite(d[[yc]])
      d <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]

      if (nrow(d) == 0) {
        stop("no rows after filtering with filter ", i, ": ", paste(names(f), f, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
        return(list(
          reps = setNames(vector("list", length(ycols)), ycols),
          mean = setNames(vector("list", length(ycols)), ycols)
        ))
      }

      # split by rep (store per ycol)
      by_rep <- split(d, d$rep)

      reps_by_y <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) {
        lapply(by_rep, function(x) {
          o <- order(x[[tick_col]])
          data.frame(tick = x[[tick_col]][o], y = x[[yc]][o])
        })
      })
      names(reps_by_y) <- ycols

      # mean per tick (per ycol)
      mean_list <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) {
        m <- aggregate(d[[yc]], by = list(tick = d[[tick_col]]), FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
        names(m)[2] <- "y"
        m <- m[order(m$tick), ]
        all_ticks <<- c(all_ticks, m$tick)
        all_vals  <<- c(all_vals,  m$y)
        m
      })
      names(mean_list) <- ycols

      ci_list <- if (show_ci) {
        out <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) replicate_ci(d, tick_col, yc))
        names(out) <- ycols
        out
      } else {
        setNames(vector("list", length(ycols)), ycols)
      }
      if (show_ci) {
        for (ci in ci_list) all_vals <<- c(all_vals, ci$lower, ci$upper)
      }

      list(reps = reps_by_y, mean = mean_list, ci = ci_list)
    })

    if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- range(all_ticks, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- range(all_vals,  na.rm = TRUE)

    plot(NA, NA, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
         xlab = labels$x, ylab = labels$y, main = labels$title)

    for (i in seq_along(summaries)) {
      col_i <- cols[i]
      s <- summaries[[i]]

      for (j in seq_along(ycols)) {
        yc <- ycols[j]
        lty_j <- ltys[j]
        if (yc == "optimum") color = "black" else color = col_i

        # Confidence band across replicate means at each tick.
        ci <- s$ci[[yc]]
        if (show_ci && yc != "optimum" && !is.null(ci) && nrow(ci) > 0) {
          ci_col <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(color, alpha.f = ci_alpha),
                             error = function(e) color)
          polygon(c(ci$x, rev(ci$x)), c(ci$lower, rev(ci$upper)),
                  col = ci_col, border = NA)
        }

        # replicate points for this y column
        if (show_rep && length(s$reps[[yc]]) && yc != "optimum") {
          col_rep <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(color, alpha.f = rep_alpha),
                              error = function(e) color)
          for (rp in s$reps[[yc]]) {
            if (nrow(rp) > 1) {
              if (style == "dot") {
                points(rp$tick, rp$y, col = col_rep, pch = 16, cex = cex_point)
              } else if (style == "line") {
                lines(rp$tick, rp$y, col = col_rep, lwd = lwd_rep, pch = 16)
              }
            }
          }
        }

        # mean line for this y column
        m <- s$mean[[yc]]
        if (!is.null(m) && nrow(m) > 1) {

          if (yc == "optimum") {
            m <- make_step_line(m)
          }
          if (style == "dot") {
            points(m$tick, m$y, col = color, pch = 16, cex = cex_point)
          } else if (style == "line") {
            lines(m$tick, m$y, col = color, lwd = lwd_mean, lty = lty_j)
          }
        }
      }
    }

    invisible(NULL)
  }

plot_generic_x_mode <- function(df, filters, ycol_single, labels, show_rep, cols,
                                xlim, ylim, xcol, lwd_mean, rep_alpha, show_ci,
                                ci_alpha) {

  if (is.null(cols)) cols <- rep("black", length(filters))
  if (length(cols) < length(filters)) cols <- rep(cols, length.out = length(filters))

  subsets <- vector("list", length(filters))
  all_x <- numeric(0)
  all_y <- numeric(0)

  for (i in seq_along(filters)) {
    f <- filters[[i]]
    d <- apply_filter(df, f)

    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      subsets[[i]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    d[[xcol]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[xcol]]))
    d[[ycol_single]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[ycol_single]]))
    d <- d[is.finite(d[[xcol]]) & is.finite(d[[ycol_single]]), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      subsets[[i]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    subsets[[i]] <- d
    all_x <- c(all_x, d[[xcol]])
    all_y <- c(all_y, d[[ycol_single]])
    if (show_ci) {
      ci <- replicate_ci(d, xcol, ycol_single)
      all_y <- c(all_y, ci$lower, ci$upper)
    }
  }

  if (!length(all_x) || !length(all_y)) {
    warning("No data to plot after filtering.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- range(all_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- range(all_y, na.rm = TRUE)

  plot(NA, NA,
       xlim = xlim,
       ylim = ylim,
       xlab = labels$x,
       ylab = labels$y,
       main = labels$title)

  for (i in seq_along(subsets)) {
    d <- subsets[[i]]
    if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) next

    col_i <- cols[i]
    col_pts <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(col_i, alpha.f = rep_alpha),
                        error = function(e) col_i)

    if (show_ci) {
      ci <- replicate_ci(d, xcol, ycol_single)
      ci_col <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(col_i, alpha.f = ci_alpha),
                         error = function(e) col_i)
      polygon(c(ci$x, rev(ci$x)), c(ci$lower, rev(ci$upper)),
              col = ci_col, border = NA)
    }

    x_vals <- sort(unique(d[[xcol]]))

    mean_x <- numeric(0)
    mean_y <- numeric(0)

    for (xv in x_vals) {
      dx <- d[d[[xcol]] == xv, , drop = FALSE]
      y <- dx[[ycol_single]]

      if (show_rep) {
        points(jitter(rep(xv, length(y)), amount = diff(range(all_x))*0.005),
               y,
               col = col_pts,
               pch = 16,
               cex = cex_point)
      }

      mu <- mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
      sdv <- sd(y, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (!is.finite(sdv)) sdv <- 0

      # Preserve the existing SD bars unless the CI band is requested.
      if (!show_ci) {
        arrows(xv, mu - sdv,
               xv, mu + sdv,
               angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.04,
               col = col_i, lwd = max(1, lwd_mean * 0.5))
      }

      points(xv, mu,
             pch = 21,
             bg = col_i,
             col = col_i,
             cex = 1.1)

      mean_x <- c(mean_x, xv)
      mean_y <- c(mean_y, mu)
    }

    if (length(mean_x) >= 2) {
      o <- order(mean_x)
      if (style == "dot") {
        points(mean_x[o], mean_y[o], col = col_i, pch = 16, cex = cex_point)
      } else if (style == "line") {
        lines(mean_x[o], mean_y[o], col = col_i, lwd = lwd_mean)
      }
    }
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

  if (identical(xcol, tick_col)) {
    plot_tick_mode(df, filters, ycol, labels, show_rep, cols, xlim, ylim,
                   tick_col, lwd_mean, lwd_rep, rep_alpha, ltys,
                   show_ci, ci_alpha)
  } else {
    # generic x mode: assume one column; if user passed multiple, take first
    plot_generic_x_mode(df, filters, ycol[1], labels, show_rep, cols,
                        xlim, ylim, xcol, lwd_mean, rep_alpha, show_ci,
                        ci_alpha)
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

# Tick/time-series interface. `tick_col` is always used as the x axis.
plot_lines_multi_tick <- function(
  df, filters, ycol,
  labels = list(title = NULL, x = "Tick", y = ycol),
  show_rep = TRUE, cols = NULL, xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL,
  tick_col = "tick", lwd_mean = 3, lwd_rep = 1, rep_alpha = 0.35,
  ltys = NULL, style = "dot", cex_point = 1,
  show_ci = FALSE, ci_level = 0.95, ci_alpha = 0.20
) {
  .plot_lines_multi_impl(
    df = df, filters = filters, ycol = ycol, labels = labels,
    show_rep = show_rep, cols = cols, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
    tick_col = tick_col, lwd_mean = lwd_mean, lwd_rep = lwd_rep,
    rep_alpha = rep_alpha, xcol = tick_col, ltys = ltys, style = style,
    cex_point = cex_point, show_ci = show_ci, ci_level = ci_level,
    ci_alpha = ci_alpha
  )
}

# Generic-x interface. Supply the column to use for x explicitly.
plot_lines_multi_generic_x <- function(
  df, filters, ycol, xcol,
  labels = list(title = NULL, x = xcol, y = ycol),
  show_rep = TRUE, cols = NULL, xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL,
  tick_col = "tick", lwd_mean = 3, lwd_rep = 1, rep_alpha = 0.35,
  ltys = NULL, style = "dot", cex_point = 1,
  show_ci = FALSE, ci_level = 0.95, ci_alpha = 0.20
) {
  if (identical(xcol, tick_col)) {
    stop("For tick-based plots, use plot_lines_multi_tick().")
  }
  .plot_lines_multi_impl(
    df = df, filters = filters, ycol = ycol, labels = labels,
    show_rep = show_rep, cols = cols, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
    tick_col = tick_col, lwd_mean = lwd_mean, lwd_rep = lwd_rep,
    rep_alpha = rep_alpha, xcol = xcol, ltys = ltys, style = style,
    cex_point = cex_point, show_ci = show_ci, ci_level = ci_level,
    ci_alpha = ci_alpha
  )
}

# Backward-compatible dispatcher for existing notebooks.
plot_lines_multi <- function(..., xcol = NULL, tick_col = "tick") {
  if (is.null(xcol) || identical(xcol, tick_col)) {
    plot_lines_multi_tick(..., tick_col = tick_col)
  } else {
    plot_lines_multi_generic_x(..., xcol = xcol, tick_col = tick_col)
  }
}
```
